title: Comparison of Cyriax Manipulation and Decompression in LDP
brief_summary: In this study, compare the effects of Cyriax manipulation and Decompression in patient with lumber disc prolapseThis research will provide an important addition to the evidence based treatment intervention in physical therapy in the field of manipulation as there is no such research work have been done on comparative study of cyriax manipulation and decompression in lumber disc protrusion.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients having Lumber disc prolapse of L1-L5 and S1 (both gender)
* Patients having MRI reports of protruded disc

Exclusion Criteria:

* Inflammatory condition( systemic inflammatory disease of spine)
* Spinal diseases (other than Musculoskeletal)
* Severe radiculopathies (bilateral)
* Operated patients (spine)
